description_en: Creates a snapshot for a disk
description_zh: 为指定的磁盘创建快照
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id d-bp18kjxg9ebrhsgi0000 --snapshot-name test-SnapshotName --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server to which the disk is attached
parameters.help_zh: 指定磁盘对应的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The snapshot name. The name must be 2 to 50 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can only contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 快照名称。长度为2~50个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag to add to the snapshot. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://. The tag key cannot start with acs: or aliyun
fields.help_zh:
为快照指定的标签键。N 的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag to add to the snapshot. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
为快照指定的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to add to the snapshot. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
